Maya: Quick Q — Alex had to rebook return flight yesterday due to a medical emergency and ended up staying two extra nights. Original return was 2026-03-18. Can we reimburse the extra hotel + the airline change fee? Also wondering about per-diem pro-rata for the extension, and whether we need an unredacted medical note. @Sam any special workflow since part of this was charged on personal card when the company card failed?

Sam: Sorry to hear that. Short answer: reimbursable with docs. Need the following to process without exception: itemized hotel folio for the extra nights; airline rebooking/change fee receipt; proof of flight change (itinerary/PNR). For medical: a physician note that confirms dates and that travel was delayed for medical reasons — diagnosis not required (see legal). If the employee paid personally, submit the personal card receipt + a short attestation and we'll reimburse. I'll expedite once everything's attached. :white_check_mark:

Priya: A few practicals: for international charges, convert to USD using the transaction date in Expensify. If any taxi/meal receipts are missing but <$25, you can upload the card statement line plus a brief note. Attach boarding passes and the original booking confirmation so we can reconcile.

Liam: I approved a provisional manager exception in our 1:1 so finance has manager sign-off. Please include my approval note in the expense submission so we don't hit a hold.

Oliver: Legal here — employees may redact PHI from medical notes. Acceptable: a brief provider statement with dates and that treatment/observation was required. Do not include the specific diagnosis unless the employee chooses to provide it. We can accept the redacted doc and a manager attestation.

expensify-bot: Expense draft created: 2048123456-ALEX-HOTEL-REBOOK. Reminder: upload itemized folio + airline rebooking receipt + attestation. Missing docs will cause auto-hold.

Maya: Thanks — noted. Alex will redact the note and upload tonight. Also one more: per-diem vs actuals?

Sam: Good question. Policy: per-diem is an option for domestic travel if pre-approved; for emergency mid-trip extensions we default to actuals reimbursed with receipts. If the traveler prefers per-diem post hoc, we can make an exception but only pro-rate by full days and require manager sign-off. For international trips, meals are reimbursed on actuals unless per-diem was selected before travel. So easiest is actual receipts for meals + hotel.

Maya: Understood. Alex paid for the last night on personal card because the company card declined at checkout (hotel attempted pre-auth and it failed). Any special code to mark that?

Sam: Mark expense as "PersonalCard-CompanyCardFailed" in the expensify memo and tag project as ENG-TRAVEL. Include last4 of personal card and a one-line explanation. Finance will flag and process it as reimbursement. If the employee needs an advance next time, we can issue an emergency advance via People Ops.

Alex: Attestation (to be uploaded):
I attest that these expenses were incurred due to a medical emergency requiring a two-night extension. I paid the final night on my personal card because the company card pre-auth failed. I authorize Redwood to reimburse me for the hotel folio and flight change fee. — Alex

Maya: Uploading docs now. Will redact per Oliver and include Liam's approval screenshot. Thanks everyone.

Sam: When you submit, toggle "expedite" and drop me a note. I'll clear it within 24-48 hours once docs look good.

expensify-bot: Submission received at 2026-03-19T21:14:03Z. Expense ID: EXP-2048123456-AH. Status: pending finance review.
